## ④ Notes

- **Carried lessons:** base merges go to the PR's own dev or the relay's `pr_update_branch` op; a bare `update-branch` is ⛔. Byte-adding PRs queue one at a time against the eager-closure ceiling. Dispatches name the whole `scripts/__tests__/` suite. A PR body becomes the squash message, so a sentence a later push made false is corrected before ready. os-dev does not patch PR bodies, so the seat writes the correction. A red `Test` aggregator on a superseded head is its shards reading `cancelled`. Before setting `pm:blocked` on an upstream, re-read that upstream's state in the same act. Grep the touched packages' READMEs for the keys a round changes.
- **Contract review:** this session does not run at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. Every contract review runs in an isolated at-tier subagent.
- **Verification layer:** a merge here reaches users through the published `@object-ui/*` packages. Landings are verified on `main` by content and by `git patch-id --stable`.
